supersedes.schema: save_shopping_list is redefined with the same signature and results (CREATE OR REPLACE): each item may also carry item_key and origins, a quantity may be NULL only with the unit «al gusto», and the list records ingredient_basis. set_shopping_items_checked is not modified (the new trigger shopping_items_check_state records checked_quantity and settles needs_review for any client). Everything else is additive: five columns on shopping_items, two on shopping_lists, three CHECKs plus one on shopping_lists, a partial unique index (shopping_list_id, item_key), and new functions. No existing row is modified.
client: Every shopping list came from one AI call over the dish titles, even for dishes with a card (C2). Now dishes with a card take its ingredients scaled to the week servings (no AI); only dishes without a card go to /api/generate-shopping-list with breakdown:true (one call, ingredients per dish).

A change of dishes made a whole new list (another AI call) and the marks stayed in the previous one. Now the current list is updated in place with reconcile_shopping_list: only the changed dishes are computed, unbought items that are no longer needed go, bought ones stay as «Comprado, ya no hace falta», and a bought item that now needs more is marked to review.
supersedes.rollout: The previous client keeps saving, reading and marking lists with this migration applied (scripts/shopping-reconcile-db-tests.cjs, rollout scenario with tests/fixtures/legacy-shopping-client-6121e34.ts), and the new client reconciles its lists in place keeping their marks. Order: migration -> code (the new client reads the new columns and falls back to the old ones on 42703). Known limit: a list with «al gusto» rows written by the new client cannot be read by a tab still running the previous client.

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX shopping_items_list_item_key_idx ON public.shopping_items USING btree (shopping_list_id, item_key) WHERE ((item_key IS NOT NULL) AND (removed_at IS NULL))

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shopping_quantity_base(p_quantity numeric, p_unit text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT p_quantity * CASE lower(btrim(coalesce(p_unit, '')))
    WHEN 'kg' THEN 1000 WHEN 'kilo' THEN 1000 WHEN 'kilos' THEN 1000
    WHEN 'kilogramo' THEN 1000 WHEN 'kilogramos' THEN 1000
    WHEN 'l' THEN 1000 WHEN 'litro' THEN 1000 WHEN 'litros' THEN 1000
    WHEN 'cl' THEN 10
    ELSE 1 END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shopping_item_valid(p_name text, p_quantity numeric, p_unit text, p_category text, p_item_key text, p_origins jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT char_length(btrim(coalesce(p_name, ''))) BETWEEN 1 AND 120
    AND char_length(btrim(coalesce(p_unit, ''))) BETWEEN 1 AND 40
    AND ((p_quantity > 0 AND p_quantity <= 100000)
         OR (p_quantity IS NULL AND lower(btrim(p_unit)) = 'al gusto'))
    AND coalesce(p_category IN ('frutería', 'carnicería', 'pescadería', 'lácteos', 'despensa', 'congelados', 'otros'), false)
    AND (p_item_key IS NULL OR char_length(p_item_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200)
    AND (p_origins IS NULL OR (
      jsonb_typeof(p_origins) = 'array'
      AND octet_length(p_origins::text) <= 16384
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_origins) AS o(origin)
                      WHERE jsonb_typeof(o.origin) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object')));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.shopping_list_json(p_list_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'id', l.id,
    'week_id', l.week_id,
    'generated_at', l.generated_at,
    'week_signature', l.week_signature,
    'ingredient_basis', l.ingredient_basis,
    'reconciled_at', l.reconciled_at,
    'items', (
      SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', s.id, 'name', s.name, 'quantity', s.quantity,
        'unit', s.unit, 'category', s.category, 'checked', s.checked, 'item_key', s.item_key,
        'origins', s.origins, 'checked_quantity', s.checked_quantity, 'needs_review', s.needs_review,
        'removed_at', s.removed_at) ORDER BY s.created_at, s.id), '[]')
      FROM public.shopping_items s WHERE s.shopping_list_id = l.id))
  FROM public.shopping_lists l
  WHERE l.id = p_list_id;
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER shopping_items_check_state BEFORE UPDATE OF checked ON public.shopping_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION shopping_items_check_state()
